_about: Customer mail drafts for twikey_xray.py month, per language. Drafts only: the user checks them and sends them. One mail per customer. Placeholders: {customer}, {invoices}, {amount}, {failure_date}, {new_date}, {mandate}, {expiry_date}, {company}. In month.json they hold codes, in the work pack the real values. {invoices} is one line per open debt, built from item (or item_no_invoice when the invoice is not known), or from item_repeat when the collection was presented more than once, or from item_part_paid when part of it was paid since (the line names what is still open). body_many (and subject_many, where there is one) replaces body (and subject) when the mail lists more than one debt. new_attempt asks for funds (AM04, insufficient funds), new_attempt_neutral is for the other reasons worth a new attempt. amount_unknown, new_date_unknown and mandate_unknown are literal placeholders the user fills in. The body is a list of lines.
